title: geum urbanum subvar. opulifolium
intro: Geum urbanum subvar. opulifolium, commonly known as wood avens, is a perennial plant species belonging to the rose family (Rosaceae). Wood avens has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The plant's therapeutic actions include wound healing, anti-inflammatory effects, and antioxidant activity, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils. The bioactive constituents in wood avens have been found to possess anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may contribute to its potential health benefits and therapeutic uses.
